text:
Maria: ScarletBank wants to kick off a POC — they require SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (delta + bulk), RBAC with AD group sync, domain controls (TXT verification), and a completed security questionnaire. They also asked for Dedicated pricing and committed throughput numbers by Friday. Can eng/security chime in?
Alex: Ack. We'll need their IdP metadata and which NameID format they expect. Also confirm ACS URL and whether they want SP-initiated or IdP-initiated flows.
Sam: Please drop the security questionnaire PDF here; we'll answer SOC2 status, encryption (KMS/HSM), key rotation, and data residency. Quick Q: do we log SCIM events with user-attributed audit IDs? We should confirm retention.
Jordan: For SCIM, we support PATCH ops and incremental (delta) syncs. Default group mapping is `members -> roles`. If they need claim-based RBAC we'll map groups to roles on ingest. Example SCIM PATCH body we usually share:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/2819c223-7f76-453a-919d-413861904646
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{"op":"replace","path":"name.givenName","value":"Jane"}]
}
```
Maria: ScarletBank also asked about domain verification for tenant isolation — do we require DNS TXT or can they upload a verification file?
Alex: We support TXT or HTTP file verification. DNS example to send them:
`_redwood-verification.scarletbank.com TXT "rbw-tenant-abc123"`
Sam: Also capture these controls they flagged: SAML signing cert rotation policy, SCIM provisioning least-privilege model, admin actions audit trail retention (they want 1 year). For Private/Dedicated we can commit to 1-year audit retention; hosted defaults to 90 days unless enterprise add-on.
Maria: Pricing ask — they want Dedicated monthly commit vs hosted pay-as-you-go. Ops/finance, can you give a ballpark?
Jordan: Ballpark: Dedicated reserved GPU pod ~ $18k/month per pod (depends on shape), plus throughput tiers (per-10k token/req) and enterprise private flat license ~$10k/month for support/compliance. I'll loop in finance for an official quote.
Alex: Next steps: schedule a 45m technical call tomorrow; I'll collate IdP metadata + SCIM attribute-mapping doc and drop answers to the questionnaire in this thread.
Maria: Great — I'll DM ScarletBank to grab IdP metadata and the completed questionnaire; assigning @Jordan to tenant provisioning once we have SAML metadata. :raised_hands:
oncall-bot: Reminder: create trial tenant request ticket #TB-4321 for ScarletBank POC
Maria: Thanks — keeping Friday deadline in mind. I'll update the thread with the completed questionnaire and attach the docs.
